elements_selected.content: X25519 ephemeral padding generator per REQ-3422 + ADR-3413 (BUG-001 resolution). Generates tier-sized {10, 30, 100, 300, 1000} padded recipient lists. Each padding entry: generate X25519 keypair, take pubkey, zeroize + discard privkey before returning pubkey. Padding entries MUST be structurally indistinguishable from real X25519 recipients in the age header. Deterministic test: the private-key discard is verifiable via a trait that asserts `ZeroizeOnDrop`. Unit test that real + padded = tier value exactly.
